assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the PR-204 denial
CPT 93229 is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The clinical concern is for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R42
There is a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The transient cerebral ischemic attacks are coded as G45.9
The note states that prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness
